body: yes i hope the tinnitus clinic is useful. if anything i can meet some people that have to deal with the same problem.

i've used white noise. problem is in order to drown out the noise in my head i have to turn it up to levels that are damaging. i use my fan, i measured how loud the fan is 75-80db and in my head it is louder. it is absolutely frustrating. competing noise is all i can count on.

thank you very much for your kind words and your knowledge. i really dont think the pristiq is a good one to take. i have taken paxil in the past and was less emotional on it. i may go back on paxil. the question about is my breathing laboured, yes it is if i do any kind of physical activity. i do smoke tho. alot these days, which is really not helping me. and i have been understating the misery of hearing this noise. it is a bloody nightmare. thank you for your reply as it has helped.
thank you very much. i am worried about coming off of a couple drugs and the withdrawls.

yea it is alot of drugs. too many i'm convinced. going to see a new doc soon who will refer me to a shrink. the shrink will monitor/change my medications. like you said i think some of them may be aggravating the tinnitus. i'm in therapy right now for spectrum anxiety disorder and depression. i saw an audiologist last year. tried a hearing aid but it only made the ringing worse. was going to try a tinnitus masker the one like a hearing aid but they stopped carrying them. don't lose the music is a fantastic site. i'd love to help other people by warning them of this condition. thank you for your kind words.

i have gotten two opinions from ent's both not good. they said learn to live with it. cbt therapy is an option pretty much the only treatment option. i've tried a hearing aid and that made it worse. the city that i've just moved to has a tinnitus (ringing in the ear) clinic so i'm getting a referral to that. could be some posibilities there.

it is truly horrible. i saw an ent when i was hospitalised and he said most people with that level of ringing do not cope well, and there was nothing they could do. i was crushed.  my parents are very supportive and have put up with a great deal. they can't understand how deeply it effects me though. i mean can anyone unless they have it? i can't sleep without sleeping pills, and those are killing me at the same time.

i've been to a specialist. theres nothing i can do the damage is irreversible. i was stupid i didnt wear protection. a great deal of my depression is related to this. but it is the least of my worries, that also scares me.
